metadata.question: Does the surface water extent in Etosha Pan decrease from mid-January, 2020 to around late August, 2020?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use JRC Global Surface Water Monthly History (JRC/GSW1_4/MonthlyHistory) for Jan 2020 and Aug 2020 over a polygon approximating Etosha Pan. If missing, fallback to Sentinel-2 SR (COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED) windows: 2020-01-10..2020-01-20 and 2020-08-20..2020-08-31.
2. Masking strategy: JRC monthly has built-in water classes; treat 0 as No Data and 2 as Water. For Sentinel-2 fallback, mask clouds via QA60 and compute NDWI; water = NDWI > 0.2. Report valid pixel counts and cloud percentage (S2).
3. Logic for Valid Zero vs Null: If collections empty after fallback -> C1. If valid pixel count after masking is 0 for either date -> C2. If computed areas are null/NaN -> C3. Otherwise compare areas; if August < January by at least max(1% of Jan, 0.5 km²) -> A, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const roi = ee.Geometry.Polygon(
      [[[15.8, -18.6], [17.2, -18.6], [17.2, -19.8], [15.8, -19.8], [15.8, -18.6]]],
      null, false
    );
    const scale = 1000; // meters
    const roiAreaKm2 = await getInfo(roi.area({maxError: 1}).divide(1e6));

    // Target periods
    const janStart = '2020-01-01';
    const febStart = '2020-02-01';
    const augStart = '2020-08-01';
    const sepStart = '2020-09-01';

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check (JRC first, fallback to S2 if needed)
    const janJRC = await getJRCMonthStats(janStart, febStart, roi, scale);
    const augJRC = await getJRCMonthStats(augStart, sepStart, roi, scale);

    let janStats = janJRC;
    let augStats = augJRC;

    // Fallback for any missing month via Sentinel-2 NDWI
    if (!janJRC.exists) {
      const janS2 = await getS2WindowStats('2020-01-10', '2020-01-20', roi, scale);
      janStats = janS2;
    }
    if (!augJRC.exists) {
      const augS2 = await getS2WindowStats('2020-08-20', '2020-08-31', roi, scale);
      augStats = augS2;
    }

    // Handle C1: Empty collection for one or both points
    if (!janStats.exists || !augStats.exists) {
      console.log(`ROI area km²: ${roiAreaKm2.toFixed(1)}`);
      console.log(`Jan2020 imgs: ${janJRC.size}, Aug2020 imgs: ${augJRC.size}`);
      console.log('One or both months have no images even after fallback.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing validation (C2 if no valid pixels after masking)
    if (janStats.validPix <= 0 || augStats.validPix <= 0) {
      console.log(`ROI area km²: ${roiAreaKm2.toFixed(1)}`);
      console.log(`Valid pixels -> Jan: ${janStats.validPix}, Aug: ${augStats.validPix}`);
      console.log('No valid pixels after masking for one or both months.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation & sanity checks
    const janWaterKm2 = janStats.waterAreaKm2;
    const augWaterKm2 = augStats.waterAreaKm2;

    const badJan = janWaterKm2 === null || isNaN(janWaterKm2);
    const badAug = augWaterKm2 === null || isNaN(augWaterKm2);
    if (badJan || badAug || janWaterKm2 < 0 || augWaterKm2 < 0) {
      console.log('Calculation failure (null/NaN/invalid).');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Output concise evidence
    console.log(`ROI area km²: ${roiAreaKm2.toFixed(1)}`);
    console.log(`JRC sizes -> Jan: ${janJRC.size}, Aug: ${augJRC.size}`);
    if (janStats.src === 'S2') {
      console.log(`Jan2020 [S2]: imgs=${janStats.size}, validPix=${janStats.validPix}, waterPix=${janStats.waterPix}, valid_km²=${janStats.validAreaKm2.toFixed(1)}, water_km²=${janWaterKm2.toFixed(1)}, cloud%=${janStats.cloudPct.toFixed(1)}`);
    } else {
      console.log(`Jan2020 [JRC]: imgs=${janStats.size}, validPix=${janStats.validPix}, waterPix=${janStats.waterPix}, valid_km²=${janStats.validAreaKm2.toFixed(1)}, water_km²=${janWaterKm2.toFixed(1)}, water%=${(100*janWaterKm2/Math.max(1e-6,janStats.validAreaKm2)).toFixed(1)}`);
    }
    if (augStats.src === 'S2') {
      console.log(`Aug2020 [S2]: imgs=${augStats.size}, validPix=${augStats.validPix}, waterPix=${augStats.waterPix}, valid_km²=${augStats.validAreaKm2.toFixed(1)}, water_km²=${augWaterKm2.toFixed(1)}, cloud%=${augStats.cloudPct.toFixed(1)}`);
    } else {
      console.log(`Aug2020 [JRC]: imgs=${augStats.size}, validPix=${augStats.validPix}, waterPix=${augStats.waterPix}, valid_km²=${augStats.validAreaKm2.toFixed(1)}, water_km²=${augWaterKm2.toFixed(1)}, water%=${(100*augWaterKm2/Math.max(1e-6,augStats.validAreaKm2)).toFixed(1)}`);
    }

    const deltaKm2 = augWaterKm2 - janWaterKm2;
    const pctChange = (deltaKm2 / (janWaterKm2 === 0 ? 1 : janWaterKm2)) * 100;
    console.log(`Δ water (Aug - Jan) km²: ${deltaKm2.toFixed(2)} (${pctChange.toFixed(1)}%)`);

    // 6. Decision with tolerance
    const tolKm2 = Math.max(0.01 * janWaterKm2, 0.5);
    const answer = (augWaterKm2 < (janWaterKm2 - tolKm2)) ? 'A' : 'B';
    console.log(answer);
  } catch (err) {
    const msg = ('' + err).slice(0, 200);
    console.log(`Error: ${msg}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

// Helpers
async function getInfo(eeObj) {
  return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => eeObj.getInfo(resolve, reject));
}

async function getJRCMonthStats(start, end, roi, scale) {
  const col = ee.ImageCollection('JRC/GSW1_4/MonthlyHistory')
    .filterDate(start, end)
    .filterBounds(roi);
  const size = await getInfo(col.size());
  if (!size || size === 0) {
    return { exists: false, size: 0, src: 'JRC' };
  }
  const img = ee.Image(col.first()).select('water');
  const validMask = img.gt(0);    // 0 = No Data
  const waterMask = img.eq(2);    // 2 = Water

  const counts = ee.Image(1).rename('c');
  const validPix = await getInfo(counts.updateMask(validMask).reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
  }).get('c')) || 0;
  const waterPix = await getInfo(counts.updateMask(waterMask).reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
  }).get('c')) || 0;

  const pixelArea = ee.Image.pixelArea();
  const validArea = await getInfo(pixelArea.updateMask(validMask).reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
  }).get('area'));
  const waterArea = await getInfo(pixelArea.updateMask(waterMask).reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
  }).get('area'));

  const validAreaKm2 = validArea ? validArea / 1e6 : 0;
  const waterAreaKm2 = waterArea ? waterArea / 1e6 : 0;

  return {
    exists: true,
    src: 'JRC',
    size: size,
    validPix: validPix,
    waterPix: waterPix,
    validAreaKm2: validAreaKm2,
    waterAreaKm2: waterAreaKm2
  };
}

function maskS2sr(img) {
  const qa = img.select('QA60');
  const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10;
  const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11;
  const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0));
  return img.updateMask(mask);
}

async function getS2WindowStats(start, end, roi, scale) {
  const col0 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
    .filterDate(start, end)
    .filterBounds(roi)
    .filter(ee.Filter.lte('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 90));
  const size = await getInfo(col0.size());
  if (!size || size === 0) {
    return { exists: false, size: 0, src: 'S2' };
  }
  const col = col0.map(maskS2sr);
  const comp = col.median();

  // NDWI = (G - NIR) / (G + NIR)
  const ndwi = comp.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']).rename('ndwi');
  const validMask = ndwi.mask();
  const waterMask = ndwi.gt(0.2);

  const counts = ee.Image(1).rename('c');
  const totalPix = await getInfo(counts.reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
  }).get('c')) || 0;
  const validPix = await getInfo(counts.updateMask(validMask).reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
  }).get('c')) || 0;
  const waterPix = await getInfo(counts.updateMask(waterMask).reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
  }).get('c')) || 0;

  const pixelArea = ee.Image.pixelArea();
  const validArea = await getInfo(pixelArea.updateMask(validMask).reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
  }).get('area'));
  const waterArea = await getInfo(pixelArea.updateMask(waterMask).reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
  }).get('area'));

  const validAreaKm2 = validArea ? validArea / 1e6 : 0;
  const waterAreaKm2 = waterArea ? waterArea / 1e6 : 0;
  const cloudPct = totalPix > 0 ? 100 * (1 - validPix / totalPix) : 100;

  return {
    exists: true,
    src: 'S2',
    size: size,
    validPix: validPix,
    waterPix: waterPix,
    validAreaKm2: validAreaKm2,
    waterAreaKm2: waterAreaKm2,
    cloudPct: cloudPct
  };
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
